title: Coding Agent Workspace & Dependency Caching Selection: Git Worktree + uv/pnpm Hardlink/Reflink Store vs. Cold Clone & pip/npm

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Cold git clone + Uncached pip install & npm install per Sandbox
tiers.recommended_scenario: Anti-pattern (wastes 2.75 minutes and 4.8GB disk I/O per agent task)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Per-Repo Pre-Baked Fat Docker Image (18 GB Image per Repo)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Fixed benchmark suites (SWE-bench static repo snapshots) without frequent lockfile edits

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Git --reference-if-able + Local DevPI / Verdaccio HTTP Proxy Cache
tiers.recommended_scenario: Legacy pip/npm workflows (still bottlenecked by 28s zip decompression of 85k files)

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Bare-Repo Git Worktree / OverlayFS + uv/pnpm Content-Addressed Hardlink/Reflink Store
tiers.recommended_scenario: Production Coding Agent fleets (0.80s workspace ready — 206x faster, 99.2% less disk)
